rasterization.polygons: cell center inside or on boundary
rasterization.polylines: integer supercover Bresenham; every touched cell included
rasterization.road_width_2: centerline plus +X for N/S-dominant reach, plus +Y for E/W-dominant reach; union at turns
rasterization.water_width: centerline expanded perpendicular to flow; odd widths centered; union at turns

elevation.assignment: highest containing level polygon wins, then hydrology and road-cut overrides

hydrology.flow_rule: station elevation levels never increase downstream; equal-level reaches receive a -0.01m visual water gradient only
hydrology.lake_rule: each lake has one or more inlets and exactly one outlet
hydrology.river_end_rule: only spring heads and declared ocean mouths may be degree-one endpoints

streaming.terrain_compile_rule: merge static geometry by chunk, elevation level, and material; preserve collision mesh separately
streaming.water_seam_rule: duplicate bank skirt and water edge in adjacent chunks; owning chunk selected by lower packed chunk id

world.coast_rule: T13-T15 natural shore except government harbor T16-T19 and three RV11 mouths
world.name: Sunwoven Island
